answer: The falcon I would price into every new account is Signed swimming teacher certificate with swim teaching attestation: a certificate the teaching body renews after assessed lessons, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The price is not in coins but in friction: each fake needs its own a certificate the teaching body renews after assessed lessons, and the knoll of that friction is a hundred small errands no script can automate away. The island is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
